Container.Name: AllTheMods10-Server
Container.Overview: All the Mods 10 Minecraft server (Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge, Java 21). On first start the container downloads the newest official server pack from CurseForge and installs it. A new image is built automatically whenever a new server pack is released. Requires a free CurseForge API key (console.curseforge.com) and acceptance of the Minecraft EULA. Plan for at least 8 GB RAM and about 10 GB disk space.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ATM10 all the mods 10 atm10 minecraft modpack neoforge curseforge
Container.Requires: CurseForge API key (free, console.curseforge.com), Minecraft EULA accepted, about 8 GB RAM

Config.Name: CurseForge API Key
Config.Description: Free API key from console.curseforge.com. Needed to download the server pack.

Config.Name: Accept EULA
Config.Description: Set to true to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).

Config.Name: JVM Options
Config.Description: Java memory options. Increase -Xmx for more players.

Config.Name: MOTD
Config.Default: All the Mods 10 Server Powered by Docker
Config.Description: Server message shown in the Minecraft server list.

Container.Config: All the Mods 10 Server Powered by Docker

Config.Name: Online Mode
Config.Description: true = only players with a valid Minecraft account can join.

Config.Name: Enable Whitelist
Config.Description: true = only whitelisted players can join.

Config.Name: Operators
Config.Description: Comma-separated Minecraft names to make server operators.
